subject: Community meetup — venue deposit, PO routing and vendor setup

Subject: Community meetup — Oak & Pine deposit and reimbursement request

Hi Laura / Evelyn,

We're sponsoring a small local user group meetup at Oak & Pine on Aug 14. The organizer (Maria) sent an invoice for the venue deposit — $1,200 due to hold the space. Estimated total event spend is ~$3,000 (venue + catering + swag + meetup snacks).

Ask: can finance approve routing this as an Events PO for cost center 4100-350, and confirm whether we use PO or corporate card for the $1,200 deposit? If we need a vendor setup / W9 I can get Maria to push that over.

Attached: oak_pine_invoice_1200.pdf (invoice for deposit)

Quick timeline:
- Deposit: $1,200 payable within 7 days to secure date
- Final payment: ~3–5 days before event (approx. $1,800)

If we can get a PO number this week I can confirm with Maria and avoid losing the date.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

Hi team,

Finance here. We can issue an Events PO for the deposit and final payment, but we need the following before we can complete vendor onboarding / PO routing:

1) Vendor form or W9 (PDF) from Oak & Pine (tax ID)
2) Billing contact and bank wiring instructions (if they prefer ACH/wire)
3) A brief estimate of total spend (we have $3,000 as a working number) and whether any meals include alcohol (affects approval routing)

If they can accept a PO, we'll push a PO number within 48 business hours after vendor setup. If they require card, we can do virtual card for the $1,200 but that may add a processing fee — roughly 2.9% (finance prefers PO when possible).

Link to vendor setup form: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/secure/VendorForm

Please attach the W9 and billing info to this thread.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai

Thanks for the quick responses. Maria attached a signed W9 and confirms they accept a PO. Maria — attaching the W9 you sent for finance (vendor_W9_maria_lopez.pdf).

- Cost center: 4100-350 (Field Marketing events)
- Estimated total spend: $3,000 (venue $2,000, catering $700, swag and misc $300)
- Alcohol: No (non-alcoholic refreshments only)
- Preferred payment: PO accepted; vendor is ok with standard 30-day net after event but will accept deposit up front to hold date
- Billing contact: Maria Lopez (maria@oakandpine.com), phone +1 (415) 222-0199

Maria — please confirm the W9 attached is the latest and whether you prefer ACH or check for final settlement. Evelyn — please let us know when a PO number is created so I can confirm the deposit payment. If PO will take >72 hours and Oak & Pine requires deposit sooner, we'd like to request a virtual card for the $1,200 deposit as backup; please advise on processing fees.

Eventbrite link for the meetup (for headcount estimate): https://www.eventbrite.com/e/sf-redwood-usergroup-2025

Thanks all — tagging as high priority to secure the venue.
